meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把长任务的计划和进展记进文件,中断后自动接着往下做
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务要跑很多步工具调用、中途容易断线或丢掉进度
copy.tagline_en: Keep plans and progress for long tasks in files, then resume right where you left off
copy.fit_line_en: For you if tasks need many tool calls and often break or lose progress midway

howto.what: 它会在你的项目目录里建 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件,把计划、调研发现和进度写到磁盘;每完成一个阶段就更新状态、记录错误,上下文丢失或 /clear 后还能从文件接着做。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、拆解或整理多步骤项目、调研任务,或任何预计需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发;/clear 或上下文压缩后它会自动读取规划文件恢复进度。

say.text: 帮我规划这个多步骤任务,建好 task_plan.md
say.note: 会在项目目录创建规划文件并写入阶段

say.text: 读一下 findings.md,接着上次的进度继续做
say.note: 会读取磁盘上的规划文件接着执行

say.text: 更新 progress.md,记下这一步做了什么
say.note: 把本次操作追加到进度日志

howto.what_en: It keeps task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md in your project folder, writing plan, findings and progress to disk. It updates phase status and logs errors as you go, so work resumes after context loss or /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan, break down or organize a multi-step project or research task, or any work needing 5+ tool calls; after /clear or compaction it re-reads the planning files to recover.

say_en.text: Plan this multi-step task and set up task_plan.md for me.
say_en.note: Creates planning files in your project folder.

say_en.text: Read findings.md and continue from where we left off.
Update progress.md with what this step did.
say_en.note: Appends the step to the progress log.
